PLAYLISTENCHANTMENT.Normalize: Normalize volume and start all playlist (except soundboards) tracks with this volume.
PLAYLISTENCHANTMENT.Fade: Fade duration when switching playlists of this channel (except soundboards). Enable with the checkbox.
PLAYLISTENCHANTMENT.soundPreview: Sound Preview, only you can hear the played sound.
PLAYLISTENCHANTMENT.soundUploadFolderHint: Sound Files can be uploaded in this folder by drag & drop to the playlists. They will be added to the target playlist.
PLAYLISTENCHANTMENT.errorNoPlaylist: Could not add sound files, target must be a playlist

CONTROL.play: Start all active playlist tracks (except soundboards)
CONTROL.resume: Resume all active playlist tracks (except soundboards)
CONTROL.next: Jump to next track of all active playlist tracks (except soundboards)
CONTROL.previous: Jump to previous track of all active playlist tracks (except soundboards)
CONTROL.togglePlaylistLoop: Enable/disable loop for entire playlist (except soundboards)

PLAYLISTENCHANTMENT.CombatAutoSwitch: When combat starts, automatically cross-fade to a random combat playlist. When combat ends, restore the previously playing playlists.
PLAYLISTENCHANTMENT.CombatConfigHint: Select the playlists to choose from when combat starts. One playlist will be picked at random.
PLAYLISTENCHANTMENT.CombatConfigEmpty: No music playlists available in this world.
PLAYLISTENCHANTMENT.ChannelExpand: Show or hide fade and normalize settings
